model: Dynasonics TFX-500w clamp-on ultrasonic flow meter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Badger Meter Dynasonics TFX-500w clamp-on transit-time ultrasonic flow meters with the RS-485 port set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The TFX-500w's RS-485 port runs Modbus RTU or BACnet MS/TP. Over BACnet it gives flow rate and velocity (home-screen units, US and metric), net/positive/negative/gross totals as single-precision AVs and 64-bit Large Analog Values, overflow counters, unit selections, three writable cutoff settings, signal strength and four command BOs.
notes: Each total exists three ways: in home-screen units, gallons and liters; each as an AV (32-bit) and an LAV (64-bit). Map one set.
Names are the manual's descriptive names.
Writes need the meter's BACnet access setting to allow read/write; it can be set read-only.
Source: TFX-500w Clamp-On Meter BACnet MS/TP Protocol User Manual TTM-UM-02773-EN-04 (January 2022).

source.title: TFX-500w Clamp-On Meter BACnet MS/TP Protocol User Manual

integration.summary: In Main Menu > System Setup > Communication select BACnet MS/TP, set MAC and BACnet ID, match the trunk settings and choose read-only or read/write access. Read flow rate, a net or positive total and signal strength.
integration.enable: BACnet writes only work when the meter's Access setting in the BACnet MS/TP menu is read/write.
setup: Main Menu > System Setup > Communication > BACnet MS/TP: MAC 1-254, BACnet ID 0-4,194,303.
Baud (9600-115200), parity, stop bits and max MAC must match the master.
Built-in termination resistor is enabled in the communication settings.
Connecting the USB programming cable disables the RS-485 port.
gotchas: Writing BO 0 Reset Totalizers zeroes every total.
Totals overflow; the overflow counters (AV 2304-2307) count rollovers of the home-screen totals.
